Risk of Rain (2013) - OnionOS Port Instructions
================================================

To play Risk of Rain on your Miyoo Mini / Miyoo Mini Plus:

1. Obtain your legally purchased copy of Risk of Rain (2013) on PC (Steam or GOG).
2. Copy the game's data file:
   - Copy `data.win` from your PC installation into this folder:
     `/mnt/SDCARD/Roms/PORTS/Games/Risk of Rain/`
3. (Recommended) If you want maximum performance and zero RAM pressure (< 28 MB textures),
   run the offline PC optimizer on your PC before transferring:
     python tools/optimize_ror_assets.py --input <path_to_game> --output <path_to_game_mmp>
   This will produce `data_mmp.win` which is pre-quantized to 16-bit RGB565 and downsampled.
   If `data_mmp.win` is present, it will be automatically prioritized!
4. Insert your MicroSD card into the Miyoo Mini Plus and launch "Risk of Rain"
   from the Ports menu (Ports -> Action -> Risk of Rain).
